business_problem: Oncoclínicas&Co needed to unify fragmented patient communication channels, reduce wait times and automate routine interactions without losing the personalized and empathetic experience patients expected.
solution_summary: Oncoclínicas&Co engaged IBM and PROA.AI to redesign its digital engagement model around a governed automation and AI stack. The solution uses IBM watsonx.ai for natural-language processing and generative AI, IBM Cloud Pak for Business Automation with RPA to automate workflows such as scheduling and follow-up tasks, and IBM Cloud Pak for Integration to connect WhatsApp, chat and email through a single secure integration layer. Governance controls were added to align with Brazil’s LGPD requirements and reinforce trust. In practice, patient requests enter through unified digital channels, are routed through the integration layer, processed by automation and AI services, and then returned as real-time responses, confirmations and proactive reminders. The architecture lets Oncoclínicas scale service interactions across more than 140 units while keeping support consistent and timely.

solution_components.name: IBM watsonx.ai
solution_components.role: Provides the generative AI and natural-language-processing layer used to understand patient requests and generate responses.

solution_components.name: IBM Cloud Pak for Business Automation
solution_components.role: Automates scheduling and other patient-service workflows through RPA and workflow tooling.

solution_components.name: IBM Cloud Pak for Integration
solution_components.role: Unifies WhatsApp, chat and email under a single secure integration framework.

data_flow: Patient messages from WhatsApp, chat and email flow through IBM Cloud Pak for Integration, where automation and watsonx.ai services classify, respond to and trigger workflows such as scheduling updates and reminders before results are returned through the same channels.
business_outcome: Oncoclínicas&Co sharply reduced waiting and disconnects, improved appointment attendance and raised patient satisfaction while scaling digital engagement across its oncology network.
metrics: 75% lower disconnection rates, bringing it down to 10% from 40%
